summary: Opt-in Miniflare/workerd integration against real local D1, Durable Objects and R2. Run selected tests serially to limit scratch storage and memory pressure.

key_files.project-content-miniflare.integration.te: Default D1 admission, ProjectRoom reference and R2 registry/byte transport path.
key_files.project-content-multipart.integration.te: Product-limit Resource HTTP/R2 round trip with one reusable request-part buffer and incremental download hashing; large Document replication, private staging, resume, publication/abort races, corruption and TTL cleanup. Never deep-compare large byte arrays or allocate an entire product-limit object.
key_files.gateway-schema.integration.test.ts: #345: web/drizzle gateway migration applied in workerd D1. Required tables, Drizzle column parity, no FKs or body columns, ledger indexes, official/BYOK disjointness, and a conditional-batch hold -> settle round trip with idempotent replay and counter/ledger invariants.
key_files.gateway-price-book.integration.test.ts: #352: admin draft/publish through /api/v1/admin/gateway, /gateway/v1/chat/completions charging the published version (drafts never), settled rows unchanged by a newer version, and an idempotent top-up funding the tenant wallet. Deletes the versions it publishes.
key_files.gateway-data-plane.integration.test.ts: #347: gateway-core contract (including non-stream chat through createGatewayApp with a fetch-stub upstream) over the D1 ports in workerd, and /gateway/v1/chat/completions through createApp: official route, spoofed x-user-id ignored, coded 401/403/501/502 without upstream text.
key_files.test-worker.ts: Local integration Worker bindings and existing durable runtime entrypoints.
key_files.remote-plugin-media.integration.test.ts: #214: an echo-style remote plugin (fake fetch) through real admission, Durable Run, ProjectRoom and R2. A Project Asset reference arrives as a fetchable signed capability; the output uploaded through /assets/plugin-output is published once across a retried invocation under the same pre-assigned id; a reference trashed after admission fails reference_unavailable and an un-uploaded or foreign answer fails contract_violation on the node. Also resolveCloudTimelineMedia for server render.
Shared request_timeline_render command through NodeProcessor, GenerationWorkflow and publication against a fake render-server (mocked fetch): the Project-Asset-scope render node completes with a ready Project Asset keyed by its run, republish writes nothing, and a render failure is projected only while the run holds the node.
Real public createApp to ProjectRoom workerd WebSocket authorization, both raw and loro-v1, D1 API/session revocation, hibernation, JWT expiry, passive-read protection and pre-initialization rejection. Only external Better Auth get-session is mocked.
key_files.supervisor-auth.integration.test.ts: Real Supervisor storage and WebSocket authorization, including hibernated token revocation before AIChat mutation and deleted-project broadcast suppression.
key_files.project-assets.integration.test.ts: Real D1/R2/ProjectRoom import path for Project Assets: single-shot and chunked session imports, list/get/receipt, duplicate-content 409, tenant pinning, and Range/CORS bytes from the upload Worker app.
key_files.project-host.contract.integration.test.t: Shared Project Host contract against the real createApp in workerd. Catalog and Project Assets must pass; Timeline host-command remains a known gap until the parallel PR lands. Also checks Timeline validation with the Function constructor disabled (deployed workerd forbids code generation; the vitest pool allows it).
